title: A Unified Approach to Quantifying Algorithmic Unfairness: Measuring Individual & Group Unfairness via Inequality Indices
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it. The study proposes a unified framework for measuring algorithmic unfairness and analyzes tradeoffs between individual-level and group-level fairness, using datasets with race and gender as sensitive attributes.
